A one-layer transformer with no LayerNorm and no biases. Vocabulary of 97 tokens; the input is a sequence of 3 tokens; the output is 96 logits read at the last position.
  x = W_E[tokens] + W_pos; 4 causal attention heads of size 32; x = x + relu(x @ W_in) @ W_out; logits = x[last] @ W_U
context: Tokens 0..95 are opaque symbols; token 96 is '='. Every input has the form 'x y ='. The output is one of 96 classes.
